key_idea: From above, a disc hides every smaller disc under it.
steps: From above you see the top disc, the pink one.
The yellow disc is wider than the pink one, so its edge shows.
The green disc is smaller than the yellow one, so it is hidden. The blue disc is wider than the yellow one, so it shows.
The orange disc is smaller than the blue one, so it is hidden. The purple disc is the widest, so it shows.
Pink, yellow, blue and purple: 4 discs.

choice_feedback.A: More than 2 discs stick out around the discs above them.
choice_feedback.B: You also see the edge of the blue disc, because it is wider than the yellow one.
choice_feedback.C: The green disc is hidden under the wider yellow disc.
choice_feedback.E: The green and orange discs are hidden under wider discs.
